derivation_note: Reconstructed, not captured. The playlist golden follows the upstream inline parse test in voicefox/source/src/apple/api.rs:538-551 (id pl.abc, 华语精选, curatorName 'Apple Music', trackCount 50, description.standard '每日更新'). Playlist-search rows and the filtered cases are placeholder samples exercising parser branches.
model_gap_note: upstream parse_playlist also records creator (artistName, else curatorName; api.rs:237-241), a canonical link ({home}/{storefront}/playlist/{id}; api.rs:243) and a {kind}_id extra (api.rs:244); musid-dli's Playlist model has no creator/link/extra fields, so those are dropped on port — the parser never reads them (source_apple.rs apple_parse_playlist). description falls back to the bare 'short'/'standard' variants upstream (api.rs:229-236) but musid-dli reads only description.standard.

description_fallback_gap.note: upstream api.rs:230-234 falls back to attributes.description as a plain string; musid-dli only reads description.standard, so a bare-string description yields None here

empty_case.note: an empty data array is valid and yields zero playlists
